serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I must say that this place looks horrible… Windows are covered up, dust is everywhere. Are you sure that you alone can take care of this place?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Thank you for your concern. Sadly I wasn’t created for cleaning up and renovation. I was never supposed to be a one-man crew. In addition, the size of this church and lack of believers are not helping the cause. 
You: Why was no one sent here to help if things are so bad?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: At first Holy Capital wanted to sell this land to the city. No one was coming here anyway and the building is only a few decades old. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Then the great economic crisis hit. There is not much interest in this parcel, and the Church doesn’t want to sell it dirt cheap. It’s a stalemate.
That sounds horrible! No more money for the Church?! Gosh darn it~
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Right now I’m de facto guarding this place against devastation and other hostile activities. 
You: Hostile activities?! Is this place dangerous? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Right now it’s safe. I'm sure of it.
You: How?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I can automatically connect to the closest private police patrol or specialized social worker squad nearby. This shortens the response to 16 minutes. That’s an average value.
You: Well, someone can do a lot of bad stuff in this amount of time.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I know. That’s why I also got a 9mm parabellum weapon inside my corpus.
You: Huh?
You: I don’t think I heard you right. {{wi}}Did you just say that you have a gun?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: From a legal point of view it’s not a gun. Guns for personal use are banned in this state. I’m equipped with lethal security measures. Similar AI powered solutions are in almost every corporation's HQ.
You: How come AI’s can have guns, but humans not? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: AI defensive units minimize collateral damage to minimum and they almost never make mistakes.
…{{wi}} That was something I regret discovering. I need to change the topic real quick.
